Subject: Your geographical-indication dispute matter - CS(COMM) 2579/2021

Dear Ms. Reddy,

Thank you for meeting us on 19 July 2021 about your dispute with M/s Hegde Exports. As we understand it, a conflicting trademark was registered.

Our advice is to file a rectification petition against the conflicting trademark. Please collect the trademark registration and the GI registration and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs. 3,04,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan
